title: lane manifest directory holds manifests only: move the lead files out
body:
Evidence: .krn/runs/lanes/ holds lane manifests (src/lane/manifest.ts) and lead files of another owner (briefs/, gold.md, *.md prompts, publish logs). #1565 moved manifests to .krn/runs/lane-manifests/ and needed a legacy read path; its review (rounds 4-5, .krn/runs/review/) reproduced id shadowing, a pruned copy reappearing live, and a boundary gap, so the move was dropped from #1565.
Outcome: the manifest directory holds manifests only: the lead files move out of .krn/runs/lanes/ (their writers and readers point at the new place), manifests stay where they are, so no reader ever reads two directories; the STORES entry stays.
Proof: a boundary test fails if a non-manifest file is written into .krn/runs/lanes/; grep finds no writer of .krn/runs/lanes/ outside src/lane/manifest.ts.
Files: scripts/boundaries.ts, the lead-file writers, .agents/skills/delivery-lead/
